mapper.sql: FROM ad_click_settlement s JOIN ad_click_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id LEFT JOIN ad_click_ledger l ON l.ledger_id=s.ledger_id AND l.qualification_id=s.qualification_id
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=9
SELECT quote_id FROM ad_click_quote WHERE quote_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.quote_id FROM ad_click_quote q JOIN ad_click_settlement s ON s.qualification_id=q.quote_id WHERE s.state='HELD' AND q.expires_at <= statement_timestamp() ORDER BY q.expires_at,q.quote_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
SELECT subject_key FROM ad_click_quote WHERE quote_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_click_receipt(receipt_id,qualification_id,subject_key,payload_hash,kind,visible_duration_ms,min_visible_ratio_bps,page_visible) VALUES(#{receiptId},#{qualificationId},#{subject},#{payloadHash},#{kind},#{visibleDurationMs},#{minVisibleRatioBps},#{pageVisible}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ,r.receipt_id,r.kind,r.status,r.canonical_receipt_id,r.accepted_at,r.decided_at,r.payload_hash JOIN ad_click_receipt r ON r.qualification_id=s.qualification_id WHERE r.receipt_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_click_receipt SET status=#{status},canonical_receipt_id=#{canonicalReceiptId},accepted_at=#{acceptedAt},decided_at=#{decidedAt} WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_click_rate(user_id,minute_start,accepted_count) VALUES(#{userId},date_trunc('minute',clock_timestamp()),0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM ad_click_rate WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_click_rate SET minute_start=date_trunc('minute',#{now}::timestamptz), accepted_count=CASE WHEN minute_start=date_trunc('minute',#{now}::timestamptz) THEN accepted_count+1 ELSE 1 END, updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND (minute_start <> date_trunc('minute',#{now}::timestamptz) OR accepted_count < #{limit})

UPDATE ad_click_settlement SET visible_receipt_id=#{visible},click_receipt_id=#{click},ledger_id=#{ledger},state=#{state},close_reason=#{reason}, closed_at=#{closedAt},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE qualification_id=#{qualificationId} AND state='HELD' AND version=#{version}
